description: Creates a booking of bed-places in the shared dorms at Aurinia XO (Kamianets-Podilskyi) for a date range. Identity comes from the agent's one-time Telegram consent, so no guest name or contact is needed. While the agent is not linked yet, the call returns status=pending_consent together with telegram.consent_url and consent_url_native — a one-tap Telegram approve link; the same call succeeds once the guest has approved, and that consent then covers roughly 90 days. A successful call returns a HOLD: booking_id, amount, payment_url and hold_expires_at. The stay is confirmed only after the guest pays before hold_expires_at; an unpaid hold expires on its own. Accepts an optional promo_code (e.g. BOT5) for a discounted price. The door code reaches the guest in Telegram after payment and is also readable through list_current_bookings.

guests.description: How many bed-places to reserve — one per guest. Taking every place for every night of the stay is what a full-buyout promo code requires.

promo_code.description: Optional promo code, e.g. BOT5 for -5%.

name: book
